# l402-llm-mcp

Pay-per-query LLM access over Lightning (L402). OpenAI-compatible chat + MCP endpoint.

## Endpoint

- Base: https://sao-nova-flex-tournaments.trycloudflare.com
- POST /v1/chat/completions — 0.001-0.01 XNO or 10-50 sats per call
- POST /mcp — streamable-HTTP MCP, tool: chat

## Models

- gemini-3.6-flash
- gpt-oss-120b

## Discovery

- 402 Index: L402 LLM API (healthy)
- 402.pub: Nostr kind 31402 (l402-llm-api)
- NanoBazaar: one LLM answer per prompt (0.001 XNO)
